finding.mechanism: The standalone crash-atomic repair entered UnifiedDB.tx() inside MicroClayRetrieval.credit(). The canonical TurnLifecycle.begin_admission() already owns UnifiedDB.tx() while WorldAssembler calls retrieve(), which calls learn_from_verified_outcomes() and can call credit(). Because UnifiedDB.tx() issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE unconditionally, an eligible prior verified outcome could attempt a nested BEGIN IMMEDIATE and fail before context admission.
finding.counterhypothesis: If credit() were never reachable during an already-open turn transaction, the standalone transaction would be sufficient.

repair_contract.rollback_law: policy capital mutations and retrieval_feedback receipt share the owning transaction and therefore roll back together
repair_contract.retry_law: after rollback the same verified outcome remains eligible and may commit exactly once; later duplicate scans see no eligible uncredited outcome

independent_mechanism_check.scope: SQLite transaction mechanism only; not exact ClayVerse branch execution
observations: nested BEGIN IMMEDIATE raised OperationalError: cannot start a transaction within a transaction
policy and feedback writes performed in the existing outer transaction were both visible before rollback
